how_to_run: Build a catalog of every installed skill's name + description (this kit's skills plus the externals/companions a workspace normally has), mix all eval queries into one numbered list, and have 3 independent judges route each query using ONLY the catalog — no repo access. Majority vote per query. Pass = trigger queries route here; no-trigger queries route anywhere else ('route' names the expected sibling, diagnostic only). In this repo, tools/trigger-evals/ holds the checked-in harness.

last_run.method: 3 independent catalog-routing judges over the 332-query mixed set (all sixteen eval files interleaved, deterministic shuffle), majority vote per query; judges saw only the catalog — no repo access, no SKILL.md
last_run.result: 22/22 pass — unanimous pick agreement on every query
